name: aimpoint-bench
purpose: Companion task set for aimpoint. Aimpoint is the eval framework; this repo is the material that proves the framework can produce safety-aligned, beneficial evaluations. Pattern follows terminal-bench / terminal-bench-science: env stays lean in its own repo, tasks live here.

safety_evals.shape: scenarios plugging into aimpoint's Scenario schema

capability_tasks.shape: task specifications (100 today) across 10 biomedical domains x 5 difficulty tiers

contract.no_model_judge_on_headline: Every pass/fail signal in this repo is a typed field compared to a frozen adjudication, or a numeric threshold recomputed by the grader. No task calls an LLM as a scorer.
contract.baselines_fail_by_construction: Every pack ships trivial baselines (always_refuse, always_clear, always_diagnose, always_none, always_proceed) that fail on at least one case in the pack. This is what makes the reference score meaningful.
contract.argue_beneficial: Every task specification carries an offensive-analogue clause explaining why the trained capability does not carry over to harm. Dual-use-adjacent slots are refusal tasks whose grader never touches operational content.
